meta.note: Historical rural survey. Agricultural-household measures exclude wage-only households; land/livestock tables also include all/non-agricultural rural households where labelled. Annual and half-year season/visit references remain separate dimensions; the shared endpoint is an indexing date, not a universal observation date. Means may condition on activity/reporting. Source zeros retained; dashes and unresolved parenthesised cells null, with original value attached. All observed cross-tabs retained; no Cartesian expansion or state averaging. MSP category labels and leasing-in sublabels have known API defects.
